  What an addon can do

  An addon is one or more .lua files the client loads at startup. It runs in a
  sandbox: it can read game state and draw UI, but it cannot touch the network, run external
  programs, or reach files outside its own folder. Addons are disabled when first installed and you
  turn them on in the addon manager, so nothing you download runs until you allow it.

  A first addon

  Create Lua/hello.lua in your game folder, enable it in the addon manager, and it
  greets you on load and shows a small panel that tracks your health.

  local labelId

function ShroudOnStart()
    ShroudConsoleLog("Hello, " .. ShroudGetPlayerName())
    local panel = ShroudUIPanel(20, 20, 200, 44)
    labelId = ShroudUIText("HP: " .. ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth, 18, 30, 30, 180, 26)
    ShroudSetTextParent(labelId, panel)
end

function ShroudOnUpdate()
    ShroudModifyText(labelId, "HP: " .. ShroudPlayerCurrentHealth)
end

  From here, read the Guide to install, package, and share addons, and
  the API Reference for every function you can call.
